themeCards.title: 30Y at a two-decade high is the US rates / equity / USD test
themeCards.fact: AP Tuesday: S&P 7,691.76 (−0.7%), Nasdaq −1.3%; 10Y 4.70% (from 4.72%); 30Y ticked lower but still near highest since 2007. BLS: import −0.4% (fuel −7.2%; nonfuel +0.4%). themeCards.mechanism: Chips sold on duration, not on a trend-break print. Headline import −0.4% is fuel; nonfuel +0.4% does not clear the 30Y two-decade line. Housing starts −12.4% is the mortgage/duration echo. Minutes today split pause-odds vs long-end supply.

themeCards.title: China July demand miss is an A-share, CNY, and China-rates story
themeCards.fact: NBS: July IP +4.5% y/y (miss vs +4.8%); retail +0.6% (miss vs 1.5%); Jan–Jul FAI −6.7% (miss vs −6.2%); jobless 5.2%. 财新: IP also +0.11% m/m. Inbox: 金龙中国指数下跌 (Aug 19 市场一览, CLAIM). 见闻 year-dated: 上证 +0.19% to 3,990.30.
themeCards.mechanism: Retail/FAI are the weak leg — that is the A-share domestic beta and the reason not to read overnight OMO as easing. CNY stays a second-order book. CICC CLAIM (Aug 8): 7月中国PMI回落 vs 发达扩张; 中国利率或加快下行、海外高位运行 — not a new July NBS note.
themeCards.trigger: August NBS that re-accelerates retail/FAI, or a credit rebound that shows up in FAI.
themeCards.invalidator: August prints that reverse the 0.6/−6.7 miss.

themeCards.title: Oil is Iran-CLAIM beta — not a Hormuz flow print
themeCards.fact: AP: Brent $91.02 (+0.2%); oil still swinging on whether tankers can exit the Gulf. 见闻 (year-dated): Trump said no talks now or later; Hormuz as “US territory” CLAIM; Iran says the strait stays closed until conditions are met. Inbox Aug 19: 霍尔木兹对峙持续，特朗普称没有与德黑兰会谈；阿联酋暂停对伊商业往来 (CLAIM).
themeCards.mechanism: Isolation/ceasefire CLAIM is not a Hormuz closure. It is an oil-beta headline and a USD/JPY twitch until a dated flow shock. Pair with the Brent row in Market closes; do not promote desk “微涨” to a settle.
themeCards.trigger: Confirmed strike on flows or a dated ceasefire extension.
themeCards.invalidator: Quiet oil with no flow disruption.

themeCards.title: Overnight OMO is China-rates plumbing, not a demand offset
themeCards.fact: 第一财经: PBOC overnight reverse-repo Aug 14 and Aug 17–19, daily cap 6,000亿元 (CNY600bn). Today is the last day of that window.
themeCards.mechanism: Give-quantity cash, not a rate signal. It does not restart retail/FAI and should not be stacked on the NBS miss as “easing.” Watch allotment vs the cap into Aug 19; CNY is a side book.
themeCards.trigger: Allotment at the cap plus another weak activity print.
themeCards.invalidator: Tiny overnight prints and a firm August rebound.
